values = list(map(int, input().split()))
range_value = int(input())

values.sort()

max_items = 0
for start_idx in range(total):
    limit = values[start_idx] + range_value
    count = 0
    for j in range(start_idx, total):
        if values[j] >= values[start_idx] and values[j] <= limit:
            count += 1
    if count > max_items:
        max_items = count
